title: CaseLink: Semantic Search for Legal Cases
description: Built an NLP-powered search tool that uses legal-text embeddings and similarity ranking to surface relevant court cases beyond simple keyword matches, with an experimental occlusion method for explaining which passages drive each result.

title: Mapping Food Desert Risk Across the U.S.
description: Developed an interactive map of food desert risk scores across the United States, using machine learning and LLM-based analysis to help users explore geographic disparities in food access.

title: E-Commerce Sales: Seasonal Spending Patterns in India
description: Compared pre-monsoon and early-monsoon transaction data to study shifts in spending behavior, then evaluated Random Forest and Logistic Regression models for predicting high-value purchases.

title: Classifying Star Types
description: Explored how temperature, luminosity, and radius vary across six star types, then built a K-Nearest Neighbors model to classify stars from their physical characteristics.

title: Heart Failure Mortality Risk Analysis
description: Analyzed clinical records from 300 heart-failure patients to explore relationships between health indicators and mortality, combining visual analysis and chi-square testing with a K-Nearest Neighbors classification model.
